description: Read how each of the business's own tools performed over a date range, one row per tool, busiest first: how many conversations called it, its mean latency, and its success, error and timeout rates (0 to 1; timeouts count as errors too). Only tools the business supplied are reported. thread_count counts a conversation once per day, so one that called the tool on three days counts three times. Figures are rolled up once a day, so the most recent day may still be incomplete. Known limitation: the range may span at most 30 days, counting both ends.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

tool_name.description: Return only this tool, named as it was registered. Omit for every tool called.

name: mba_get_tool_call_insights

outputSchema.description: The tool call insights for the requested range

data.description: One row per tool called in the range, busiest first. Empty when no tool of yours was called

items.description: Call volume, latency, and health for a single tool

avg_latency_ms.description: Mean time the tool took to respond, in milliseconds, over every call in the range that was timed. Null when none were timed

error_rate.description: Share of calls that returned an error, between 0 and 1. Timeouts are errors, so they are included here as well as in timeout_rate. Null when no call in the range reported an outcome

success_rate.description: Share of calls that returned without an error, between 0 and 1. Null when no call in the range reported an outcome

thread_count.description: Conversations that called this tool, counted once per day and summed over the range. A conversation that called the tool on three separate days counts three times

timeout_rate.description: Share of calls that timed out, between 0 and 1. A subset of error_rate. Null when no call in the range reported an outcome

tool_name.description: The tool these figures cover, as you named it when you registered it. Only tools you supplied are reported

title: Read tool call insights
